# bumbleflies — Full Content Summary

> Facilitation, AI Consulting, and App Development for organizations navigating change. Based in Munich, serving the DACH region. Three founders, four service pillars, one goal: helping teams talk, decide, and build.

We help teams move from conversation to code. Our approach combines structured facilitation with hands-on technical execution — no consulting decks that collect dust, just work that sticks.

---

## Services

### Talk — Facilitation & Workshop Design

Structured dialogue that surfaces real issues and creates clarity. We design and facilitate workshops, team alignment sessions, and Open Space events — from executive offsites to sensitive community conversations. Our facilitation creates safety, surfaces truth, and produces decisions that stick. Formats include: Gesamtmoderation (full-day facilitation), Open Space, structured dialogue, team retrospectives.

### Decide — Decision-Making & Strategy

From strategic direction to operational ownership. We help teams make decisions they can actually commit to — because the right people were in the room, the right questions were asked, and the right process held the conversation. Services include: strategy workshops, decision-making frameworks, organizational design, agile transformation coaching.

### Build & Embed — Software Development

Custom software, internal tools, and AI applications built to solve real organizational problems. We don't hand off code and disappear — we embed with your team, build what you actually need, and stay through adoption. The difference between a project and a product. Capabilities: full-stack development, AI integration, internal tooling, SaaS products, DevOps.

### Full Journey — End-to-End Engagement

When the problem doesn't fit a single box. We accompany teams from first conversation through implementation — facilitation, strategy, and execution in one continuous engagement. For organizations that need a partner, not a vendor.

---

## AI Consulting

Practical AI for organizations — no hype, just results. We help teams understand what AI can actually do for their work, then implement it. Our approach: start with the problem, not the technology. We focus on human-in-the-loop AI, agentic systems, and practical automation — the kind that changes how teams work without requiring a PhD to operate.

Key areas: AI strategy workshops, agentic software development, human-in-the-loop AI systems, process automation, AI literacy training.

---

## How We Work

Our approach connects facilitation and development. We believe transformation happens through good conversation followed by concrete action. The bumbleflies method: talk to understand, decide to commit, build to sustain. We use Open Space principles, structured dialogue, and iterative development to create change that sticks.

---

## Case Studies

### Siemens AG — Enterprise Team Alignment

**Service:** Talk | **Duration:** May 2023

A large enterprise team walked in with competing priorities and unclear ownership. They walked out with clear decisions and named owners — and immediately booked follow-up sessions to sustain the momentum.

**What we did:** Full-day workshop (Gesamtmoderation) with the entire team. Structured dialogue to surface competing priorities, named ownership for each decision, action clarity for next steps. Pivoted to a replacement program when the original agenda needed adjustment.

**Outcome:** Clear decisions with explicit ownership, aligned direction across divisions, repeat bookings, sustained momentum. One focused workshop created enough clarity that multiple follow-up sessions were requested.

### LeagueSphere — Building a Regional SaaS

**Service:** Build & Embed | **Duration:** 2021–2026 (Ongoing)

American football leagues in Germany were drowning in spreadsheets. We took full ownership: deep understanding of league operations, MVP focused on core pain (scheduling + officials + results), iterative development with real leagues. From "someday we'll build this" to live product in 9 months.

**What we did:** Build phase (2021–2022): MVP, iterative dev, team adoption support. Scale phase (2022–2024): feature expansion, multi-region deployment (6+ leagues), digital pass system. Sustainability phase (2024–2026): SaaS model (€900–€5,000+/region/season), version 3.19.5, continuous iteration.

**Outcome:** Live SaaS across 6+ regional German leagues, recurring revenue, 5-year partnership, leagues actively recommend to other leagues.

### Dialograum Geld — Values-Driven Community Dialogue

**Service:** Talk | **Duration:** March 2021

A community initiative dedicated to normalizing conversations about money. We designed and facilitated an Open Space dialogue for sensitive topics: safety first, diverse participation, structured openness, values alignment, normalization of taboo topics.

**Outcome:** Difficult conversations happened authentically, community voices were heard, money moved from "forbidden topic" to "normal conversation," Dialograum demonstrated their commitment beyond theory.

### Wohnungshelden — Annual Team Alignment

**Service:** Talk | **Duration:** Annual (Jahresendretro)

Full-day Open Space retrospective combining structured reflection with community building. Morning: welcome, Open Space overview, marketplace of self-organized sessions. Thematic sessions: multiple parallel tracks, deep reflection, cross-functional participation. Evening: celebration, team building (go-kart racing, gaming).

**Outcome:** Team clarity on priorities, continued annual engagement, high participation and buy-in. An annual ritual that the team actually looks forward to.

### UnternehmerTUM — Agile Transformation at Scale

**Service:** Decide | **Duration:** 2025–2026 (Ongoing)

Multi-modal training and coaching program for agile transformation. Core offerings: agile practices for projects and product development, in-house hybrid PM training, interactive practice workshops. The blended model: structured workshops + in-house customization + ongoing coaching + scalable delivery.

**Outcome:** Recurring bookings across multiple cohorts, Talk+Decide model working together, scalable training without losing quality. Organizations that came for a workshop stayed for the transformation.

## Team

### Christoph Kämpfe — Founder & Engineering Lead

Full-stack engineer and product builder. Turns workshop insights into production tools. Believes great internal tooling and custom software are force multipliers for organizational change. Expertise: backend systems, frontend design, DevOps, custom software for organizational needs.

### Christian Dähn — Founder & Content Strategy

Facilitator, speaker, and organizational psychologist with 15+ years helping teams find their voice. From workshops to AI strategy to custom tooling. Founded bumbleflies because organizations often have the answers within themselves — they just need the right container and the right questions.

### Sebastian Keller — Founder & Product Strategy

Digital strategist and organizational designer. Shapes how bumbleflies' services fit together and ensures every engagement creates lasting impact. Obsessed with understanding how change actually sticks — through thoughtful service design that creates conditions for sustainable transformation.

---

## About

bumbleflies was founded in 2021 in Munich by three people who believed that organizations don't need more consultants — they need better conversations and better tools. We facilitate, we consult, and we build. Sometimes all three in the same engagement.
